title: GCStack+GCScaler: Fast and Accurate GPU Performance Analyses Using Fine-Grained Stall Cycle Accounting and Interval Analysis
problem: Existing GPU performance analysis tools use coarse-grained, issue-stage-centric, priority-based cycle stacks that exaggerate memory-side stalls, hide concurrent stall events, and require expensive cycle-level simulation repetition for each design variant.
motivation: GPU architects need fast and accurate design-space exploration tools; current simulation-based approaches are too slow (iterative per-design cycle simulation) and too inaccurate (misleading bottleneck attribution) to guide next-generation GPU design.
method: GCStack accurately identifies GPU performance bottlenecks by tracking all the different types of slowdowns (memory delays, synchronization waits, and idle cycles) that happen simultaneously in each cycle, instead of just the most important one. GCScaler predicts how these slowdowns change across different GPU designs using mathematics, without re-running expensive simulations. Together, they enable exploration of 1,000 GPU designs from a single baseline simulation.
key_novelty: By tracking all the slowdowns that happen simultaneously and mathematically scaling those patterns to new GPU designs, the method enables accurate performance analysis and rapid exploration of 1,000 design options from a single simulation.
contributions: GCStack: fine-grained cycle stack that captures all concurrently occurring stall events per cycle, eliminating priority-based distortion
GCScaler: interval-analysis-driven analytical scaling models for stall cycles targeting alternative GPU designs
Analytical scaling models specifically for idle and synchronization stalls that are not captured by existing interval analysis
32.7x design-space exploration speedup over repetitive timing simulation with 6.37% mean absolute error across 47 benchmarks and 1,000 GPU designs

metrics.speedup: 32.7x faster design exploration over repetitive timing simulation
metrics.accuracy: 6.37% mean absolute performance estimation error across 47 benchmarks

baselines: repetitive cycle-level timing simulation for GPU design-space exploration
limitations: Accuracy of 6.37% MAPE may degrade for GPU microarchitecture changes that fundamentally alter memory hierarchy behavior beyond what interval analysis can model.
primary_theme: fast and accurate GPU performance analysis and design-space exploration
